native_renders.scope: Single-worker Lambert diagnostic; warm/uncontrolled caches, CPU reference retained; no production speedup claim
native_renders.timing_notes: Wall spans may overlap across threads. Device total includes initialization and validation. Collect includes its wait. Validation includes binary-record I/O. Diagnostic I/O aggregates logging on both threads. Queue residence is summed per request, not critical-path time. GPU event interval overlaps host wait/launch. Do not sum all fields.
native_renders.transfer_timing_notes: Async htod/dtoh spans measure host enqueue cost, not completed transfers. Completion wait includes transfers and kernel. Staging is CPU memcpy. GPU kernel event timing excludes copies. One stream and one in-flight batch; no cross-batch overlap claim.

gpu_guards.scope: Standalone guard checks; native rendering is validated separately
